passages.text: Demonstration production-line operating notes. This is an authored synthetic procedure, not a manufacturer's manual. Throughput investigation: Compare completed quantity against the production target for equal-length periods. Calculate throughput as completed units per scheduled shift minute; calculate attainment as completed quantity divided by target. A fall in completed quantity alone does not identify a cause. Compare the machine-level contributions before prioritizing an inspection. Downtime investigation: Review logged downtime minutes, machine availability, planned versus actual processing time and missing records. passages.text: are a significant source of wasted energy in a compressed air system, often wasting as much as 20%-30% of the compressor’s output. Compressed air leaks can also contribute to problems with system operations, including: • Fluctuating system pressure, which can cause air tools and other air-operated equipment to function less efficiently, possibly affecting production • Excess compressor capacity, resulting in higher than necessary costs • Decreased service life and increased maintenance of supply equipment (including the compressor package) due to unnecessary cycling and increased run time. Although leaks can occur in any part of the system, the most common problem areas are couplings, hoses, tubes, fittings, pipe joints, quick disconnects,

passages.text: has seven dates and three machines. The scenario deliberately reduces machine M1 output and increases its downtime in the second period. This generator-controlled relation is a test fixture, not discovered evidence of a real failure or a causal estimate. One M2 downtime record is intentionally missing in the second period. Records should have unique machine/date pairs. Negative quantities, negative durations, processing plus downtime above the scheduled duration, or duplicate machine/date records are contradictions and should block confident reporting. Null downtime must be reported explicitly. A root cause requires external corroboration, which this database does not contain.

limitations: Downtime is incomplete: sums include known records only; missing is not zero
